text:
Priya: Quick sync — planning to enable model_v7 canary today. Proposed plan: EU 10% (observe -> 25 -> 50), US 5% (observe -> 20). Main asks: confirm guardrails, rollback triggers, and who's watching first 30m. Config snippet below we intend to flip.

Priya: ```json
{"feature":"model_v7_canary","scopes":[{"region":"eu","percent":10},{"region":"us","percent":5}],"auto_bump":true,"bump_steps":[25,50],"watch_window_min":30}
```

Alex: SGTM. Add hard fail triggers: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95_latency >= baseline_p95 * 1.2 for 3m. Also track token_throughput drop > 30%.

Jamie: Can we enable cache warmup for the EU slice specifically? Cold KV hits will spike p50. Suggest `cache_warmup=true` in the flag metadata.

Sean: Oncall here — I'll monitor. Please ensure we have alerts for `canary-error-rate`, `canary-latency-p95`, and `canary-tokens/s`. I'll take paging for first 30m.

Maya: I pushed a tiny infra PR to wire the flag into the rollout service: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/3456 — @Alex PTAL for config TTL nit.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: featureflag service: set model_v7_canary -> EU=10% US=5% (initiated by Priya) at 1723456890

Alex: Reviewing PR now. small nit: reduce `cache_ttl` from 600s -> 300s for the canary scope to avoid long stale stats. otherwise :+1: Approving after change.

Priya: Plan: flip EU first (10%), watch 30m. If green bump EU->25, then US 5 -> 20. If any trigger hits, we'll rollback to previous model and disable canary. Will post updates at 30m and 2h.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: alert rules created for model_v7_canary: canary-latency-p95, canary-error-rate — paging @Sean at threshold.

Sean: Got it. Commands to abort quick: `/toggle set model_v7_canary=0` or `/rollout abort model_v7`. I'll execute if we see >0.5% errors or heavy latency regressions.

Jamie: Note — watch logs for `missing-kv-cache` pattern; if that spikes it's usually a cold-start artifact and should settle. If it persists >10m, escalate.

Priya: Thanks everyone — kicking off now. I'll update thread at +30m. :rocket:
